reports.text: Margaret, 81, has dementia and left home on foot this afternoon without telling anyone. A neighbour saw Margaret set off towards the north-east. Family say Margaret walks slowly and tires quickly.
A dog walker reports seeing someone matching Margaret's description about 15 minutes ago, roughly 0.7 km north-east of the house, on a footpath.
